{{Quote|You had better be right!''"<br />"''I am a droid. I am always right.|[[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] and TX-20|audio=IAmAlwaysRight-IoR.flac|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
'''TX-20''' was a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] that was in charge of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|units]] assigned to [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Emir/Legends|Emir]] and [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]], [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Tambor ordered him to conquer the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]], which he did, leading his army to complete victory and establishing a camp in the city, at the cost of many innocent Twi'lek lives. Once the Republic debarked on Ryloth, he sent probes to spy the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|forces]]. He armed himself with courage to confront the famous [[High Jedi General/Legends|High General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and during the battle, he was able to predict the strategies and tactics of his enemies, and counterattacked them wisely. He established five [[Proton cannon/Legends|proton cannons]] in the center of the city, which was also where his [[Separatist command center/Legends|command center]] was, and stopped the advance of his opponents, forcing them to hide inside the tunnels around of the city.

The tactical droid starved some [[Gutkurr/Legends|creatures]] and sent them against the Jedi, even though his initial campaign wasn't killing them, but causing them a lot of casualties. However, TX-20 didn't count with the surprising attitude of the General, and he was forced to betray his own army when his cannons were destroyed. When he was about to kill Kenobi and [[Numa/Legends|Numa]], the liberated Twi'lek prisoners from his camp tore him to bits.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Does not compute&hellip; Does not compute&hellip;|TX-20's final words|audio=DoesNotComputer-IoR.flac|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
After the planet was secured for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]], TX-20 was tasked with protecting the five anti-aircraft [[Proton cannon/Legends|cannons]] of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] city of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]], and used the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] population of the nearby city as living shields to prevent the Republic troops from using a direct assault or bombing them in oblivion from orbit. TX-20 commanded his forces from a [[Separatist command center/Legends|Separatist command center]], and after forcing [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] three [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Acclamator class assault ships]] away, severely damaging one in the process, he was able to calculate and anticipate several moves of [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], suggesting that Kenobi would not risk the lives of prisoners and would use an unorthodox maneuver instead. To counter any move of Kenobi while preserving his own forces, TX-20 unleashed starved [[Gutkurr/Legends|gutkurrs]] onto [[Ghost Company/Legends|Ghost Company]], thinning their ranks severely. After doing this, he began to prepare for their final direct assault, computing that he now had a 742 to 1 odds of victory against the remaining Republic troops.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

[[File:TX20UnderAttack-InnocentsOfRyloth.jpg|thumb|left|200px|TX-20 is attacked by the Twi'leks.]]
TX-20's computations, while correct, lacked one critical factor: local aid to the clones. After rescuing the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] girl [[Numa/Legends|Numa]], Obi-Wan, [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]], led by the child, used the underground sewers to sneak behind the enemy line and release the captured villagers. TX-20 led his troops to face the Republic assault, but the clones only assaulted as a diversion to allow Kenobi to take control of one of the cannons and turned its fire on the other four. Turning around, TX-20 destroyed Obi-Wan's commandeered cannon, and closed in on the downed Jedi, believing that by killing him, he could still win. He was about to finish the Jedi with his [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]], when, seeing their savior and Numa (who had sneaked to the downed Obi-Wan and was attempting to drag him away) in danger, the Twi'lek villagers suddenly surged forward and mobbed the tank. TX-20 was torn apart by the Twi'leks while offering no resistance, his mechanical brain being unable to cope with the sudden turn of events.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

==Behind the scenes==
TX-20 had the letter 'T' [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] on the left side of his torso and his head; the T stands for T-series tactical droid.

TX-20 was voiced by [[Corey Burton]] in [[Innocents of Ryloth]] and is the first tactical droid to be given a designation.<ref name="Supply Lines Guides">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode303.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Supply Lines}}</ref> Count Dooku's tactical droid voiced by [[Phil LaMarr]] in [[Supply Lines]], was initially listed as "TX-20" in the end credits of the episode, however the actual model did not look nor sound like TX-20. The mistake has been corrected by [[Clone Wars Adventures|Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures]], where the droid is identified as [[TA-1313]].

A Hasbro action figure of TX-20 was created and released in [[2010]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|''The Clone Wars'' line]].
